question: If I was to make okonomiyaki for Anastasia, how would she react? Of course, not everyone from the Kansai area likes okonomiyaki, but somehow I think she would.
answer: Anastasia probably knows how to make it better than you do, so she’d probably say “You’re doing it all wrong! Hand that over! Here, this is how you make the real thing!”, and then she’d hand you a half-burned one.
